description: Source code for WebSocketDeflater class implementing compression/decompression for WebSocket data using zlib, including initialization, data addition, finishing, and output retrieval.

classes.name: WebSocketDeflater
classes.description: Class providing WebSocket data compression using zlib, managing deflate stream lifecycle and buffer handling.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the deflater with specified window bits, setting up zlib stream.

methods.name: AddBytes
methods.description: Adds data bytes to the deflater for compression.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Finalizes compression, flushes remaining data, and adjusts output buffer.

methods.name: PushSyncMark
methods.description: Inserts a synchronization mark into the output buffer.

methods.name: GetOutput
methods.description: Retrieves compressed output data of specified size.

methods.name: ResetContext
methods.description: Resets the deflate stream context based on mode.

methods.name: Deflate
methods.description: Performs deflate operation with specified flush parameter.
